title: Pet Emergency Kit
description: Use this list to pack a go-kit for each pet and set up the plan so you never have to leave animals behind.

items.text: Food for at least several days (ideally 2 weeks) in a waterproof container
Water for several days plus bowls
Medicines with written dosing instructions
Sturdy leash, harness, and collar with ID tags showing your cell number and an out-of-town contact
Carrier or crate for each animal, labeled with your contact info
Microchip each pet and confirm the registry has your current phone and address
Copies of vet records and vaccination proof in a waterproof bag
Current photos of you with each pet to prove ownership if separated
Pet first aid kit
Litter and litter box, or poop bags
Cleaning supplies: paper towels, disinfectant, trash bags
Familiar blanket, toy, or treats to reduce stress
Manual can opener if you pack canned food
List of pet-friendly hotels, boarding kennels, vets, and friends outside your area
Pet buddy: a neighbor with a key who can get your pets if you are not home
Practice carriers and short car trips so pets load quickly
Plan to evacuate early and take pets with you - never leave them chained or tied outside
Rescue alert sticker on your door listing the animals inside
For horses and livestock: trailer, transport route, and destination arranged well ahead
Rotate pet food and medicines before they expire
